name: NDC document bytes from EXISTING Internet Archive Wayback captures — second byte source for registry rows the openclimatedata mirror cannot serve
upstream_note: reads existing public captures only — never Save Page Now, never a live proxy of unfccc.int; the id_ suffix returns the capture's original bytes
rationale: follows the registry index it backfills: a monthly re-query can only find captures that already exist, and a row with none stays an honest no-archive-capture failure
